projects.title: Benevolent Heart
description: Benevolent Heart is an illustrated narrative sharing the story of a young girl by the name of Thuy. Residing in South Vietnam near the end of the Vietnam War was not the easiest for Thuy, as tensions were high and hopes were low. Nevertheless, Thuy stayed true to herself during these tough times and always tried to be kind and bring a smile to anyone and everyone's face. Her benevolent heart reached many, including a pair of sea life deities.

projects.title: The Figmental World of a Sketch Book
projects.thumbNailAlt: The Figmental World of a Sketch Book Thumbnail
projects.softwareMaterials: Paint Tool Sai, Photoshop, InDesign, Paper, Pencil
description: Sonia loves to draw. Her dad thinks it’s a waste of time. One day after failed attempts to get his daughter into other hobbies, he is magically transported into a world created from the drawings of Sonia’s sketch book. Together the two travel this mysterious world to find a way out and learn that drawing is actually super cool.

The story of resistance from parental figures to support their childrens' dreams because they think it's a foolish path is a common one for first generation Americans. I think it's important to share more stories like this to show others who are going through a similar situation that they are not alone. Here's to all the dreamers.

This project was created in collaboration with Stephanie Cen; We worked together on writing and story exploration. All other aspects, including art, formatting, lettering and more were done by me. Throughout the creation of this project I gained insight from many people including my advisor De Angela Duff and peer Yangsin Lau Vasquez.

projects.title: Metamorphosis
description: Metamorphosis is a web comic adaptation of the song Metamorphosis by Infinity Song. It follows the story of a little girl who has a dream she wants to achieve but struggles through insecurities and doubt while trying to make it come true.

When I first heard this song, it felt like a heavy weight was lifted off my shoulders. In my own journey through art, I was going through a lot of struggles and tribulations. I failed myself, experienced imposter syndrome, and had many moments where I just wanted to give it all up. It gives me solace to know that I'm not the only one going through it.
Although the fears are still there, I hope that creating this little story puts me one step closer to recognizing my worth and realizing my dreams.

projects.title: Alice's Lament
description: Alice's Lament is a colored storyboard narrative showing the origin story of Alice. Unearthly and frightening, Alice strikes a disturbingly similar appearance to that of the evil creatures told in tall tales. But Alice did not always appear this way. Witness Alice's story, the rise and fall of her happiness, and the brief life of those who taught her that kindness exists in this cruel world.

projects.title: Road Rage
description: Road Rage is a small mini game about driving down the road and putting power to road rage by giving you the ability to blow up a car on command.

projects.title: Flora! The Musical Showdown with B.B. Wolf
projects.thumbNailAlt: Flora! The Musical Showdown with B.B. Wolf
description: Flora! The Musical Showdown with B.B. Wolf is an animatic adaptation of The Three Little Pigs. This project was made in collaboration with Katie Anne Coleman and Kelsey Lynn Cretcher for SVA's MFA Visual Narrative Program. My contribution to this project includes storyboarding, prop design, video editing and sound design.

projects.title: Nurture
description: Nuture is a wordless short comic about caring for a neglected peach tree. With some tender love and care, and a little bit of time, a once forgotten tree can bear fruit again.

projects.title: Weightlessness
description: I’ll Go by Direct & Park Avenue is a song I enjoy listening to because I always get this airy, weightlessness feeling as the music builds up to the drop.
Weightlessness is a pixel manipulation art piece inspired by the song and this feeling. It was created using the p5js library.

projects.title: Treat or Trick
description: Treat or Trick is a motion graphic short story about treats, tricks, and even more tricks.

projects.title: Star Grid
description: Star Grid is a computer art piece that lets you dictate how the art looks! Customize the number of points on each star, the size of the grid, the color preset, and even the rotation of the stars in this patterned structure. And afterwards right click and save your creation!
Star Grid was created using the p5js library.
